name: implicit-line-holds-the-place-of-a-later-line
reference: spec/engine-spec.md 0.56 `implicit`: "A line that implicit leaves out is still the line that holds the place for ruling 16 of 0.5". Input 08 00 fills n and x with 0 (ruling 16 of 0.5). Encode: n is the earliest held line on path 1, 0 is left out; x (no implicit) does not write its 0 there. Output empty, not 0800. Derived by hand.
